fields.title: Add packed weight to Kestrel Family Carry-On
fields.question: q-two-kids-carry-on
fields.source: Supplier spec sheet KS-CO-22 rev C, p.2
fields.evidence: Tidewell (3.0 kg) and Northloop state weight; Muse and Gemini cite weight as a reason.

fields.title: Replace 'fits every airline' with the measured size
fields.question: q-light-carry-on
fields.proposed-value: Fits overhead bins on United, Delta and American (55 x 35 x 22 cm).
fields.source: Airline carry-on limits checked 2026-09-24 against each airline's baggage page
fields.evidence: No airline list supports 'every airline'; agents repeat claims as fact.

fields.title: State the 10-year warranty on Kestrel Voyager 28
fields.question: q-checked-hard
fields.proposed-value: 10-year limited warranty on shell and wheels
fields.evidence: Not shown in any agent for a 'lifetime warranty' question; every pick states its warranty term.

fields.title: Align Air 20 price across Shopify and Amazon
fields.question: q-light-carry-on
fields.evidence: Rufus shows $199, Muse shows $179 for the same SKU.
fields.decision-note: Hold until the Q4 promo calendar is final.

fields.title: Add laptop sleeve size to Kestrel Junior Pack
fields.question: q-kids-backpack
fields.proposed-value: Fits laptops up to 14 in (33 x 23 cm sleeve)
fields.evidence: Harbor Kids wins on a stated sleeve size.

fields.title: Add '40% more space' to Compress Cubes
fields.question: q-packing-cubes
fields.evidence: Fernway quotes 40%; we have not tested ours.
fields.decision-note: No test data. Do not copy a competitor's number.
